Question 12(c) [4 marks]: Explain how monitoring and controlling could be used in operations at this business.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Joe's Japanese is about to open in the city. They plan to run an upmarket restaurant with all meal preparation occurring in the middle of the restaurant for customers to enjoy watching.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Relates cause and effect of how monitoring and controlling could be used in operations at this business
3 marks: Provides reasons in favour of how monitoring and controlling could be used in operations at this business
2 marks: Sketches in general terms how monitoring and controlling could be used in operations at this business
1 marks: Makes a general statement of how monitoring and controlling could be used in operations at this business OR defines monitoring and/or controlling



TEACHER MARKER COMMENTS:
A lot of students did not define monitoring and controlling accurately. Monitoring is the recording of data (the weight of a product, cost etc.) and controlling is comparing the monitored data against targets. THEN a business will improve by implementing changes if necessary. Too many people got this wrong.
